map_definition.observable_economic_mark: cash + liquidatable inventory current-price mark + committed production current-price potential mark
map_definition.note: Visualization mark only; not profit, wealth, objective, or adoption score.

observation: In this fixed anchor Battle, the observable economic mark separates materially during Day0, before the previously emphasized Day4/Day8 windows.
At Day0 h17, self still has more Cash, while opponent already has +12618 current-price committed-production mark; the visible residual is therefore primarily outside Cash at that point.
By terminal, almost all remaining observable-mark residual is Cash because committed production has largely run off.
This is a one-Battle map and does not establish cross-seed timing or cause.
boundary: No Action, Representation, Evaluation, Direction, Candidate, or policy mutation.
Do not infer that Day0 h17 is the causal separator from this map alone.
Do not average across seeds until individual trajectory shape is understood.
Use component layers only after the whole-map shape identifies a region worth opening.
